fields.description:
Add the self-contained rebar MCP HTTP service to the box per ADR deft-evolutive-mosasaur: a new
`mcp` compose service + `Dockerfile.mcp` running loopback-published `rebar-mcp` HTTP, and an nginx
`/mcp/` TLS-edge location with a switchable upstream so the autodeploy slice
(panicky-sylphish-foxterrier) can flip blue→green atomically. INFRA + the `/health` code only; the
live AWS deploy is approval-gated (a human performs it). Autodeploy logic lives in foxterrier,
secrets in avians.

## Scope
- `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`: an `mcp` service (built from `Dockerfile.mcp`),
  loopback-published `127.0.0.1:8091` (Gerrit 8080, review-bot REVIEW_BOT_PORT, opcert 8090),
  `restart: always`, a `healthcheck` hitting `/health`, and `stop_grace_period: 1260s` (covers the
  1200s app SIGTERM grace + margin so Docker never SIGKILLs mid-op). Fail-closed HTTP posture via
  env: `REBAR_MCP_TRANSPORT=http`, `REBAR_MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0`, `REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PORT=8091`,
  `REBAR_MCP_HTTP_TLS_AT_EDGE=true`, `REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS`/`REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`
  (external host/origin), `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1`, `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STRATEGIES=static`,
  `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL`, `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STATIC_TOKENS_FILE`. `MCP_PATHS` for the
  autodeploy change-detector is declared as a compose comment so foxterrier can consume it.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp` (NEW): builds `rebar-mcp` from the same repo-root context +
  committed `uv.lock` as `Dockerfile.opcert` (`python:3.12-slim`,
  `uv sync --locked --no-dev --extra agents --extra mcp`). CMD boots `rebar-mcp` (http via env). A
  container `HEALTHCHECK` curls loopback `/health`.
- `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template`: a new `location /mcp/` proxying to a named `upstream rebar_mcp`
  whose `server` line is the materialized include `include /etc/nginx/mcp-upstream*.conf;` (the
  flip seam). TLS terminates at nginx (mirrors `/review/` + `/opcert/`).
- `infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` (NEW, committed seed): `server 127.0.0.1:8091;`.
- `infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh` (NEW): the concrete committed fresh-boot installer —
  copies the committed seed to `/etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` ONLY IF absent (so a foxterrier flip
  is never clobbered on redeploy), then `nginx -s reload`. Local-file seed (no SSM); idempotent.
- `infra/scripts/compose-up.sh`: call `materialize-mcp-upstream.sh` before `docker compose up`,
  beside the existing `materialize-opcert-guard.sh` call, same non-fatal WARN pattern.
- `/health` on the MCP server exposing an integer `in_flight` gauge counting ONLY certified ops
  (review_plan/verify_completion/review_code/scan_spec), plus a bounded SIGTERM grace so a retiring
  container lets an in-flight op finish. The gauge feeds foxterrier's retire check; it does not gate
  the deploy. New health/gauge/signal code lives in a NEW module `src/rebar/_mcp_health.py`
  (mcp_server.py is at its 800-LOC cap), wired from `build_server`/`main`.

## nginx switchable upstream — grounded fresh-boot + flip
An nginx `upstream {}` with ZERO `server` lines is a config error (`nginx -t`: "no servers are
inside upstream") — unlike the `/opcert/` `map` whose `default 0` makes a zero-match glob safe. So:
(1) the template GLOB-includes `mcp-upstream*.conf`; (2) this change ships the committed seed
`infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf`; (3) the NEW committed installer `materialize-mcp-upstream.sh`,
wired into `compose-up.sh`, copies that seed to `/etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` (only-if-absent)
before the stack comes up, so a fresh boot has exactly one backend and `nginx -t` passes.
Correction: NO committed script renders `rebar.conf.template` via `envsubst` today (it is only an
example comment in the template header); this plan relies only on the committed installer above.
foxterrier re-points blue→green by atomically rewriting that single file + `nginx -s reload`. The AC
renders the template WITH the seed present.

## /health auth exemption
CONFIRMED against installed `mcp` 1.29.0 (not from memory): `FastMCP.custom_route`'s own docstring
states "Routes using this decorator will not require authorization", and `streamable_http_app`
appends `_custom_starlette_routes` as bare Starlette `Route`s while wrapping ONLY the mounted MCP
endpoint in `RequireAuthMiddleware`. So under `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1` an unauthenticated probe of
`/health` returns 200; only `/mcp` enforces the `static` bearer. The in-process test asserts
`/health`→200 with auth ENABLED and no token, so the exemption is proven executably.

## SIGTERM grace (concrete numbers)
`_mcp_health.py` defines `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS = 1200` (a module constant, the
`review_bot/config.py` budget precedent — not a rebar config key). On SIGTERM the process waits up
to 1200s for `in_flight` to reach 0, then exits; compose `stop_grace_period: 1260s` covers it.

## Approach
Mirror the proven opcert edge (loopback service + nginx location) but expose a switchable upstream
rather than a hardcoded `proxy_pass host:port`, because the ADR's blue-green cutover re-points the
upstream atomically. `/health` counts only expensive ops so retirement waits on billable work, not
trivial reads. Shared base image keeps build cost low; retained images bounded by the existing prune.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] In-process ASGI (docker NOT required): `/health` from the FastMCP `streamable_http_app`
  returns JSON with an integer `in_flight`. Oracle: `in_flight` reads 0 at idle, increments while a
  stubbed certified op is held in flight, returns to 0 after — via the real endpoint through a
  Starlette TestClient; a trivial read does NOT move it (contrast). `/health` also returns 200
  WITHOUT a bearer while `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1` (auth-exemption oracle).
- [x] Fail-closed boot: a non-loopback bind with NO TLS-at-edge/allowlist ack makes `build_server`
  raise `McpStartupError` (ADR-0050 guard message); with the ack it boots. Oracle: the existing
  `_resolve_http_runtime` gates, asserted directly.
- [x] nginx `/mcp/` proxies to a named `upstream rebar_mcp` whose `server` line is the materialized
  include `mcp-upstream*.conf`; the committed seed `infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` supplies
  `server 127.0.0.1:8091;`; and `materialize-mcp-upstream.sh` (called from `compose-up.sh`) installs
  it only-if-absent. Oracle: structural parse of the rendered template + seed + installer wiring
  (`nginx -t` when a binary is available).
- [x] SIGTERM grace: with `in_flight` > 0 a SIGTERM does NOT exit immediately and exits 0 once the
  gauge drains, within the 1200s bound — a subprocess/signal test driving the `_mcp_health` grace
  handler; and `stop_grace_period` (1260s) ≥ `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` (1200s), asserted
  structurally over compose + the module.

## Testing
Starlette TestClient over `streamable_http_app` for `/health` idle/inflight/contrast + auth
exemption; direct `build_server` assertions for the fail-closed gates; structural parse of the nginx
template + seed + installer wiring; a subprocess/signal SIGTERM test; a numeric assertion tying
`stop_grace_period` to `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS`. No docker dependency.

## File impact
`infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp` (new), `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`,
`infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template`, `infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` (new),
`infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh` (new), `infra/scripts/compose-up.sh`,
`src/rebar/_mcp_health.py` (new), `src/rebar/mcp_server.py`, tests under `tests/`.

## Compat / rollback
Purely additive — new service, new port, new nginx location. Rollback = remove the `mcp`
service/location + seed + installer call (gerrit/review-bot/opcert unaffected). Trust boundary: new
authenticated endpoint — `static` bearer at `/mcp` + TLS at the nginx edge; `/health` is
intentionally unauthenticated (no secrets, only an integer gauge).

Depends on: deft-evolutive-mosasaur (ADR). Blocks: panicky-sylphish-foxterrier, unmythical-uninspired-olm.
